prompt_summary: Neon Industrial top-down tactical lab: gunmetal floor panels, inset energy trenches, readable operator and guard silhouettes, amber terminals, red security emitters, green extraction bloom, and deterministic VFX state language.
claimed_signals: Default runtime scene removes full-board grid overlay; --debug-grid is opt-in and tested.
Runtime objects are named polished render clusters: Operator Hull, Guard Drone Hull, Energy Node Ring, Terminal Console Screen, Security Turret, Extraction Gate Ring.
Playable runtime uses clean deterministic conduit segments; cookable conduit and asset graph proof remains project-bound while gameplay avoids off-screen ribbon artifacts.
Default app uses native 1600x900 presentation, MSAA, FXAA, and visual tweening for player and guard movement while keeping the simulation grid deterministic.
Terminal hack, energy reroute, extraction open, extraction complete, and defeat expose deterministic visual event ticks and HUD callouts.
HUD language is player-facing: POWER, TERMINAL, EXIT, overload bar, and restart prompt; frame/debug data remains in CLI reports.
Project contains cookable asset graphs for floor panels, cable trench, security emitters, energy lens, and extraction gate.
Generated style board is retained as project-bound art direction and validation artifact, not a runtime strict-cook dependency.
rejected_signals: debug grid as default art layer
missing restart instruction on victory/failure overlay
unsupported asset graph nodes in strict cook

presentation_quality.art_direction: Neon Industrial with controlled gunmetal surfaces, cyan-green energy, amber terminal screens, and red security language.
presentation_quality.scale_cues: Larger deterministic floor panel domains, raised machinery walls, pylons, door rails, terminal consoles, and ring nodes establish a physical lab floor.
presentation_quality.contact_shadows: 2.5D object clusters use raised primitive depth and renderer grounding to keep silhouettes attached to the surface.
presentation_quality.surface_occlusion: Aster material parameters and KTX2-backed normal/ORM/height sources carry panel wear, cavity grime, edge polish, pitting, and height shading.
presentation_quality.volumetric_depth: Clean conduit segments, compact guard warning tiles, and extraction rings show gameplay states without particle clutter.
presentation_quality.camera_language: Orthographic top-down tactical framing with debug grid hidden by default.

review.notes: Gameplay GIF review removed stray marker/projectile-style clutter, switched default presentation to MSAA/FXAA/native resolution, and added deterministic visual tweening for grid movement.
